meanings.usage: 不及物动词，常与介词on搭配，表示“靠……繁荣发展”
不可数名词，此处指硅谷宽松自由、不受过多规则约束的创新环境

meanings.meaning: 集成的，综合的，完整统一的
meanings.usage: 常用于科技领域，如integrated circuit即“集成电路”
可数名词，指供专业人员使用的高性能计算机

meanings.meaning: 处罚，使处于不利地位，损害
meanings.usage: 及物动词，常用被动语态be penalized by表示“受到……的不利影响”
不及物动词，此处指想象力不受限制地自由发挥
可修饰产品、服务等，表示根据特定需求制作的
及物动词，通常指催生大量新事物、新现象
可数名词，常与介词in/for搭配，表示某领域的对手
该词现在稍显过时，日常多用Asian指代亚洲人
及物动词，主语为组成部分，宾语为整体，不用于被动语态
常用复数形式droves，in droves表示“成群结队地，大量地”
可数名词，指引入新事物、新方法的人
及物动词，常搭配link/relationship/partnership等词，表示建立牢固的关系
可修饰名词，或用于it is crucial that/to do结构中

phrases.usage: 动词短语，表示“靠……蓬勃发展，因……而兴旺”，主语通常为企业、组织或人，后接名词或动名词

examples.en: Many tech companies thrive on constant innovation.
examples.zh: 许多科技公司靠持续的创新蓬勃发展。

examples.en: He thrives on pressure and always performs best in challenging situations.
examples.zh: 他在压力下状态很好，总是在有挑战的环境中表现最佳。

phrases.usage: 固定表达，字面意思为“回到未来”，常指事物的发展在新的条件下重现过去的模式或特点

examples.en: The popularity of vinyl records is like a back to the future moment for the music industry.
examples.zh: 黑胶唱片的流行对音乐行业来说就像是“回到未来”的时刻。

examples.en: The new policy takes us back to the future, reviving the small business support schemes from the 1990s.
examples.zh: 新政策让我们仿佛回到了未来，重启了上世纪90年代的小企业扶持计划。

phrases.usage: 连词短语，意为“就像……一样”，用于引导方式状语从句，类比两种相似的行为或情况

examples.en: You can adjust the settings of the software, much the way you customize your phone's home screen.
examples.zh: 你可以调整这个软件的设置，就像你定制手机主屏幕一样。

examples.en: The team works together to solve problems, much the way a family supports each other.
examples.zh: 这个团队协作解决问题，就像一家人互相支持一样。

phrases.usage: 副词短语，意为“成群结队地，大量地”，修饰动词，表示人或事物大规模地出现或行动

examples.en: Tourists come to this coastal city in droves every summer.
examples.zh: 每年夏天都有大量游客来到这座海滨城市。

examples.en: Residents left the earthquake-stricken area in droves to seek safer shelter.
examples.zh: 居民们成群结队地离开地震灾区，寻找更安全的避难所。

phrases.usage: 动词短语，意为“利用，凭借，依靠”，宾语通常为经验、知识、资源等抽象事物

examples.en: She drew on her childhood experiences to write the novel.
examples.zh: 她凭借自己的童年经历创作了这本小说。

examples.en: The project draws on the latest research in environmental science.
examples.zh: 这个项目利用了环境科学领域的最新研究成果。

phrases.usage: 专有名词短语，意为“环太平洋地区”，指环太平洋沿岸的所有国家和地区，常用于经济、贸易语境

examples.en: Trade between Pacific Rim countries has increased significantly over the past decade.
examples.zh: 过去十年间，环太平洋国家之间的贸易额大幅增长。

examples.en: This summit focuses on sustainable development issues in the Pacific Rim.
examples.zh: 本次峰会聚焦环太平洋地区的可持续发展问题。

phrases.usage: 名词短语，意为“垄断，牢牢控制”，常与介词on搭配，表示对某个市场、领域的绝对控制

examples.en: The company has a near lock on the global smartphone processor market.
examples.zh: 这家公司几乎垄断了全球智能手机处理器市场。

examples.en: Local businesses are trying to break the foreign brand's lock on the luxury goods market.
examples.zh: 本土企业正试图打破外国品牌对奢侈品市场的垄断。

phrases.usage: 可数名词，意为“初创企业，新成立的公司”，尤指科技领域的新兴创业公司

examples.en: Many start-ups in this city have received investment from venture capital firms.
examples.zh: 这座城市的很多初创企业都获得了风险投资公司的投资。

examples.en: He quit his stable job to join a start-up focused on artificial intelligence.
examples.zh: 他辞去了稳定的工作，加入了一家专注于人工智能的初创公司。

grammar.title: 方式状语从句：much the way引导的类比结构
grammar.structure: 主句 + much the way + 从句（完整句子）
grammar.definition: 用于比较两种动作或情况的相似性，说明主句的行为和从句的行为在方式上高度相似，相当于“就像……一样” 常用于说明文、议论文中，通过读者熟悉的场景解释不熟悉的概念，让表达更通俗易懂

examples.en: Carver Mead notes there are now workstations that enable engineers to design, test and produce chips right on their desks, much the way an editor creates a newsletter on a Macintosh.
examples.zh: 卡弗·米德指出，现在的工作站能让工程师直接在自己的桌面上设计、测试和生产芯片，就像编辑在苹果电脑上制作时事通讯一样。

examples.en: Teachers can use interactive tools to deliver online courses, much the way they teach in physical classrooms.
examples.zh: 教师可以使用互动工具开展线上课程，就像他们在实体教室里授课一样。

grammar.title: as引导的原因/伴随状语从句
grammar.structure: As + 从句（主语+谓语）, + 主句
grammar.definition: as在这里表示“随着，由于”，既可以说明主句动作发生的背景，也可以表示因果关系，从句的动作和主句的动作往往同时发生 常用于描述某种趋势、变化带来的结果，从句描述前提或背景，主句描述随之产生的现象

examples.en: As the time and cost of making a chip drop to a few days and a few hundred dollars, engineers may soon be free to let their imaginations soar without being penalized by expensive failures.
examples.zh: 随着制造芯片的时间缩短到几天，成本降到几百美元，工程师们很快就能尽情放飞想象力，不会因为失败成本高昂而受到限制。

examples.en: As renewable energy technology becomes more affordable, more households are choosing to install solar panels on their roofs.
examples.zh: 随着可再生能源技术的成本越来越低，更多家庭选择在屋顶安装太阳能板。

grammar.title: 现在分词作结果状语
grammar.structure: 主句 + ,/-- + 现在分词短语
grammar.definition: 现在分词短语放在句末，前面用破折号或逗号隔开，用来表示主句动作产生的自然而然的结果，其逻辑主语就是主句的主语 可以避免使用多个独立短句，让句子结构更紧凑，逻辑更连贯

examples.en: Mead predicts that inventors will be able to perfect powerful customized chips over a weekend at the office -- spawning a new generation of garage start-ups and giving the U.S. a jump on its foreign rivals in getting new products to market fast.
examples.zh: 米德预测，发明者们在办公室花一个周末就能做出完美的高性能定制芯片，这会催生新一代的车库初创企业，让美国在快速将新产品推向市场方面领先于外国竞争对手。

examples.en: The new subway line has been put into use, greatly reducing the travel time between the two districts.
examples.zh: 新的地铁线路已经投入使用，大大缩短了两个区之间的通勤时间。

patterns.pattern: A predicts that 从句 -- spawning B and giving C a jump on D in (doing) sth

original.en: Mead predicts that inventors will be able to perfect powerful customized chips over a weekend at the office -- spawning a new generation of garage start-ups and giving the U. S. a jump on its foreign rivals in getting new products to market fast.
original.zh: 米德预测，发明者们在办公室花一个周末就能做出完美的高性能定制芯片，这会催生新一代的车库初创企业，让美国在快速将新产品推向市场方面领先于外国竞争对手。

imitations.en: Industry analysts predict that the new 5G technology will be widely applied in rural areas -- spawning a wave of digital agricultural innovations and giving domestic farmers a jump on their foreign counterparts in improving production efficiency.
imitations.zh: 行业分析师预测，新的5G技术将在农村地区广泛应用，这会催生一波数字农业创新浪潮，让国内农民在提升生产效率方面领先于国外同行。

imitations.en: Education experts predict that the new online learning platform will be promoted nationwide -- spawning a variety of personalized teaching modes and giving students in remote areas a jump on their peers in accessing high-quality educational resources.
imitations.zh: 教育专家预测，这个新的线上学习平台将在全国推广，这会催生多种个性化教学模式，让偏远地区的学生在获取优质教育资源方面领先于同龄人。

patterns.pattern: For instance, 人物身份 + 姓名, has done sth to challenge sb's near lock on sth

original.en: For instance, Alex Au, a Stanford Ph. D. from Hong Kong, has set up a Taiwan factory to challenge Japan's near lock on the memory-chip market.
original.zh: 例如，来自香港的斯坦福博士欧德宁已经在台湾设立了一家工厂，挑战日本对存储芯片市场近乎垄断的地位。

imitations.en: For instance, Li Ming, a Tsinghua graduate from Hunan, has launched a new energy battery brand to challenge foreign companies' near lock on the power battery market.
imitations.zh: 例如，来自湖南的清华毕业生李明推出了一个新的能源电池品牌，挑战外国企业对动力电池市场近乎垄断的地位。

imitations.en: For instance, Wang Jia, a designer who returned from studying abroad, has created a series of original domestic cosmetics to challenge international luxury brands' near lock on the high-end beauty market.
imitations.zh: 例如，留学归来的设计师王佳创作了一系列原创国货彩妆，挑战国际奢侈品牌对高端美妆市场近乎垄断的地位。

patterns.pattern: Before it becomes sth, 某事物 may prove sth for (doing) sth

original.en: Before it becomes a retirement village, Silicon Valley may prove a classroom for building a global business.
original.zh: 在硅谷变成退休村之前，它或许会成为打造全球商业的课堂。

imitations.en: Before the old industrial area becomes a commercial complex, it may prove a creative base for young artists to display their works.
imitations.zh: 在这片老工业区变成商业综合体之前，它或许会成为年轻艺术家展示作品的创意基地。

imitations.en: Before the traditional paper book is completely replaced by e-books, it may prove an important carrier for passing on cultural memories for future generations.
imitations.zh: 在传统纸质书被电子书完全取代之前，它或许会成为为后代传递文化记忆的重要载体。

lines.en: anarchy Technology trends may push Silicon Valley back to the future.
lines.zh: 技术的发展趋势有可能把硅谷重新推向未来。

lines.en: Carver Mead , a pioneer in integrated circuits and a professor of computer science at the California Institute of Technology, notes there are now work-stations that enable engineers to design, test and produce chips right on their desks, much the way an editor creates a newsletter on a Macintosh.
As the time and cost of making a chip drop to a few days and a few hundred dollars, engineers may soon be free to let their imaginations soar without being penalized by expensive failures.
lines.zh: 米德--集成电路的一位先驱，加州理工学院的计算机教授--注意到，现在有些计算机工作站使工程技术人员可以在他们的办公桌上设计、试验和生产芯片，就像一位编辑在苹果机上编出一份时事通讯一样。

lines.en: Mead predicts that inventors will be able to perfect powerful customized chips over a weekend at the office -- spawning a new generation of garage start-ups and giving the U.S.
lines.zh: 由于制造一块芯片的时间已缩短至几天，费用也只有几百美元，因此，工程技术人员可能很块就可充分发挥他们的想像力，而不会因失败而造成经济上的损失。

lines.en: a jump on its foreign rivals in getting new products to market fast.
lines.zh: 米德预言发明者可以在办公室用一个周末的时间生产了完美的、功能很强的、按客户需求设计的芯片--造就新一代从汽车间起家的技术人员，在把产品推向市场方面使美国把它的外国对手们打个措手不及。

lines.en: 'We're got more garages with smart people,' Mead observes.
lines.zh: “我们有更多的汽车间，那里有许多聪明人，”米德说。
“我们确实是靠这种无政府状态发展起来的。

lines.en: Already, orientals and Asian Americans constitute the majority of the engineering staffs at many Valley firms.
lines.zh: 硅谷许多公司中工程技术人员的大多数是东方人和亚裔美国人。

lines.en: And Chinese, Korean, Filipino and Indian engineers are graduating in droves from California's colleges.
lines.zh: 中国、韩国、菲律宾和印度的工程师一批批地从加州的大学毕业。

lines.en: As the heads of next-generation start-ups, these Asian innovators can draw on customs and languages to forge righter links with crucial Pacific Rim markets.
lines.zh: 作为新掘起一代的带头人，亚裔发明家可以凭借他们在习惯和语言上的优势，与关键的太平洋沿岸市场建立起更加牢固的联系。

lines.en: For instance, Alex Au, a Stanford Ph.
D. from Hong Kong, has set up a Taiwan factory to challenge Japan's near lock on the memory-chip market.
lines.zh: 奥，一位来自香港的斯坦福大学博士，已经在台湾建厂，对日本在内存条市场上近似垄断的局面提出了挑战。

lines.en: India-born N.Damodar Reddy's tiny California company reopened an AT & T chip plant in Kansas City last spring with financing from the state of Missouri.
Before it becomes a retirement village, Silicon Valley may prove a classroom for building a global business.
lines.zh: 雷迪经营的小小的加州公司在堪萨斯城重新启用了美国电话电报公司的一家芯片工厂，并从密苏里州获取了财政上的支持。

lines.en: US NEWS AND WORLD REPORT, October 2, 1989
lines.zh: 在硅谷变成一个退休村之前，它很可能成为建立全球商业的一个教学场地。

questions.q: What does the computer industry thrive on apart from anarchy?
questions.zh: 除无政府状态之外，计算机产业还依靠什么而兴旺？
questions.a: It thrives on Asians. Already, orientals and Asian Americans constitute the majority of the engineering staffs at many Valley firms, and Chinese, Korean, Filipino and Indian engineers are graduating in droves from California's colleges.
questions.aZh: 靠的是亚洲人。硅谷许多公司中工程技术人员的大多数是东方人和亚裔美国人；中国、韩国、菲律宾和印度的工程师正一批批地从加州各大学毕业。
questions.hint: 答案出处：'We really thrive on anarchy.' 之后的 'And on Asians.' 以及紧随其后的两句。

questions.q: Why may engineers soon be free to let their imaginations soar?
questions.zh: 工程师为何不久就能自由自在地发挥想像力？
questions.a: Because the time and cost of making a chip have dropped to a few days and a few hundred dollars, so they are no longer penalized by expensive failures.
questions.aZh: 因为制造一块芯片的时间已缩短到几天、费用降到几百美元，他们不会再因代价高昂的失败而受罚。
questions.hint: 见第 3 句 As the time and cost of making a chip drop to a few days... without being penalized by expensive failures.

questions.q: What does Mead predict inventors will be able to do?
questions.zh: 米德预言发明者将能做到什么？
questions.a: They will be able to perfect powerful customized chips over a weekend at the office, spawning a new generation of garage start-ups and giving the U.S. a jump on its foreign rivals in getting new products to market fast.
questions.aZh: 他们能在办公室用一个周末做出完美的、功能强大的定制芯片，从而催生新一代车库创业公司，并使美国在迅速把新产品推向市场方面领先于外国对手。
questions.hint: 见第 4 句 Mead predicts that inventors will be able to perfect powerful customized chips over a weekend at the office。

questions.q: How can Asian innovators help next-generation start-ups?
questions.zh: 亚裔创新者能怎样帮助新一代创业公司？
questions.a: As the heads of next-generation start-ups, they can draw on their customs and languages to forge tighter links with the crucial Pacific Rim markets.
questions.aZh: 作为新一代创业公司的带头人，他们可以凭借自己的习俗和语言，与关键的太平洋沿岸市场建立起更牢固的联系。
questions.hint: 见第 9 句 As the heads of next-generation start-ups, these Asian innovators can draw on customs and languages...

questions.q: Why does Silicon Valley need both anarchy and immigrants to keep thriving?
questions.zh: 硅谷为何既需要“无政府状态”又需要移民才能持续繁荣？
questions.a: Anarchy here means a loose, free-wheeling environment of many small garages rather than rigid big firms: it lets smart people experiment cheaply and fail without ruin. Immigrant engineers then supply the skills, languages and Pacific Rim connections that carry new chips and products to world markets.
questions.aZh: 这里的“无政府状态”指一种松散自由的环境：众多小车库而非僵硬的大公司，让聪明人以低成本试验、失败也不致破产；移民工程师则带来技术、语言和太平洋沿岸的人脉，把新芯片与新产品送向世界市场。
questions.hint: 结合米德 'We really thrive on anarchy.' And on Asians. 以及 Alex Au、Reddy 两个实例，言之成理即可。

translation:
技术的发展趋势有可能把硅谷重新推向未来。
卡弗。
米德--集成电路的一位先驱，加州理工学院的计算机教授--注意到，现在有些计算机工作站使工程技术人员可以在他们的办公桌上设计、试验和生产芯片，就像一位编辑在苹果机上编出一份时事通讯一样。
由于制造一块芯片的时间已缩短至几天，费用也只有几百美元，因此，工程技术人员可能很块就可充分发挥他们的想像力，而不会因失败而造成经济上的损失。
米德预言发明者可以在办公室用一个周末的时间生产了完美的、功能很强的、按客户需求设计的芯片--造就新一代从汽车间起家的技术人员，在把产品推向市场方面使美国把它的外国对手们打个措手不及。
“我们有更多的汽车间，那里有许多聪明人，”米德说。
“我们确实是靠这种无政府状态发展起来的。
”靠的是亚洲人。
硅谷许多公司中工程技术人员的大多数是东方人和亚裔美国人。
中国、韩国、菲律宾和印度的工程师一批批地从加州的大学毕业。
作为新掘起一代的带头人，亚裔发明家可以凭借他们在习惯和语言上的优势，与关键的太平洋沿岸市场建立起更加牢固的联系。
比如说，亚历克斯。

印度出生的N.达莫达。

title: Silicon Valley
subtitle: 硅谷

lead.question: 除无政府状态外，计算机产业还依靠什么发展？硅谷为何能重新回到未来？
lead.warmup: 本篇选自 1989 年 10 月 2 日的《美国新闻与世界报道》。当时有人断言硅谷终将沦为退休村，可技术趋势却可能把它重新推向未来。卡弗·米德指出，工作站已让工程师在办公桌上设计、试验和生产芯片，时间与费用降到几天和几百美元，失败不再昂贵。车库创业随之复兴，亚裔工程师则成为新一代公司的骨干。
goals: 掌握 silicon、semiconductor、chip、campus、start-up 等科技与创业词汇
理解并运用被动语态，如 without being penalized by expensive failures
熟练使用现在完成时与定语从句描述硅谷的人才与产业
能用英语讨论技术创新、移民人才与创业环境等话题
lead.summary: 米德指出，工作站让芯片的设计、试验与生产缩减到几天、几百美元，工程师的想像力不再因昂贵失败受罚。他预言发明者能在办公室用一个周末做出定制的强力芯片，催生新一代车库创业公司，使美国在产品上市上抢得先机。硅谷依靠的，是无政府状态与亚洲人：东方人和亚裔美国人已是公司工程人员的主体。
lead.tips: 易错提醒：thrive on 意为“靠……兴旺发达”，介词 on 不可换成 in 或 with；garage start-ups 指车库起家的创业公司，不是汽车修理厂；give sb a jump on 是使某人抢先于对手，与“跳跃”无关。

exercises.q: 汉译英：由于制造一块芯片的时间与费用降到几天和几百美元，工程师们很快就能自由地让想像力翱翔，而不会因昂贵的失败受到惩罚。
exercises.a: As the time and cost of making a chip drop to a few days and a few hundred dollars, engineers may soon be free to let their imaginations soar without being penalized by expensive failures.

exercises.q: 汉译英：在硅谷许多公司里，东方人和亚裔美国人构成了工程技术人员的大多数。
exercises.a: Orientals and Asian Americans constitute the majority of the engineering staffs at many Valley firms.

exercises.q: 句型转换：将 Work-stations enable engineers to design, test and produce chips right on their desks. 改为被动语态。
exercises.a: Engineers are enabled by work-stations to design, test and produce chips right on their desks.
exercises.note: enable sb to do 变被动

exercises.q: 填空：There are now work-stations ____ enable engineers to design, test and produce chips right on their desks.
exercises.note: 定语从句关系代词作主语

exercises.q: 填空：Alex Au, a Stanford Ph.D. from Hong Kong, ____ (set up) a Taiwan factory to challenge Japan's near lock on the memory-chip market.
exercises.note: 现在完成时表已完成的动作

exercises.q: 改错：We are got more garages with smart people.
exercises.a: We've got more garages with smart people.

exercises.q: 汉译英：这家公司的园区里有一家半导体工厂，生产用于工作站的芯片。
exercises.a: The company's campus houses a semiconductor plant which produces chips for work-stations.

quiz.q: 课文说，除无政府状态之外，计算机产业还依靠什么而兴旺？
options: Tariffs on foreign rivals
Government financing
Asians
Cheaper real estate
quiz.note: 原文 'We really thrive on anarchy.' And on Asians.

quiz.q: 制造一块芯片的时间与费用如今已降到什么程度？
options: A few months and a few thousand dollars
A few days and a few hundred dollars
A few hours and a few cents
A few weeks and a few million dollars
quiz.note: drop to a few days and a few hundred dollars。

quiz.q: 米德预言发明者能在办公室用多长时间做出功能强大的定制芯片？
options: A single afternoon
A whole year
Ten years
A weekend
quiz.note: perfect powerful customized chips over a weekend at the office。

quiz.q: 关于硅谷许多公司的工程人员构成，课文怎么说？
options: Orientals and Asian Americans constitute the majority of the engineering staffs.
Almost all the engineers are native-born Americans.
Asian engineers are rarely hired in the Valley.
Most engineers graduated from European universities.
quiz.note: Already, orientals and Asian Americans constitute the majority...

quiz.q: 来自香港的斯坦福博士 Alex Au 做了什么？
options: He financed a chip plant for the state of Missouri.
He reopened an AT&T plant in Kansas City.
He set up a Taiwan factory to challenge Japan's near lock on the memory-chip market.
He retired and moved to a small village.
quiz.note: 见 Alex Au 一句；重开堪萨斯城芯片厂的是 Reddy。

quiz.q: 课文末句对硅谷的未来作了怎样的展望？
options: Silicon Valley has already turned into a retirement village.
Silicon Valley may prove a classroom for building a global business before it becomes a retirement village.
Silicon Valley will soon close down all its chip plants.
Silicon Valley can teach nothing about global business.
quiz.note: Before it becomes a retirement village, Silicon Valley may prove a classroom...
